**Finding: missing (critical)** — no indemnification clause exists in the Agreement.

**What I found**
- The outline jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability); Section 20 is entirely absent.
- Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless", and "defend" turned up only incidental references that presuppose an indemnity: § 19.4 ("indemnified claims"), § 21.3 (indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims), § 30.5 (vested indemnity rights).
- § 9.3 expressly cross-references "the remedies required by Section 20.5" — a broken reference, confirming the deleted section.
- With no Vendor IP indemnity at all, this sits in walk-away territory, not merely below fallback.

**Redline proposed (validated ok:true)** — new Section 20 inserted after § 19.5, at the preferred position:
- 20.1 Vendor defence/indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents, and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, covering Customer and its Affiliates.
- 20.2 Customary exclusions (unauthorized Customer modifications, combinations, Customer specifications).
- 20.3 Narrow Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law, with an express "no other indemnity" statement.
- 20.4 Standard procedure: notice (prejudice qualifier), control of defence, cooperation at indemnitor's cost, no adverse settlements without consent.
- 20.5 Procure/modify/replace, then terminate-and-refund — restoring the § 9.3 cross-reference.

Note: § 21.3 already treats indemnification obligations as Excluded Claims, so the new indemnity sits outside the liability cap without further edits — no super-cap fallback needed.
